description: This file declares the interface for managing rbus messages, including creation, cloning, serialization/deserialization, adding and retrieving various data types, and managing message lifecycle through reference counting.

methods.name: rtMessage_Create
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new rtMessage instance.

methods.name: rtMessage_Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing rtMessage, copying only the data fields.

methods.name: rtMessage_FromBytes
methods.description: Creates an rtMessage from a byte buffer.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArray
methods.description: Serializes an rtMessage into a byte array.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArrayWithSize
methods.description: Serializes an rtMessage into a byte array, allocating buffer based on a suggested size.

methods.name: rtMessage_FreeByteArray
methods.description: Frees the byte array previously allocated by serialization functions.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetString
methods.description: Adds or sets a string field in the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddString
methods.description: Adds a string field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddBinaryData
methods.description: Adds binary data to the message under a specified field name.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a nested message as a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetArrayLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of an array field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringItem
methods.description: Retrieves a string item from an array field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessageItem
methods.description: Retrieves a message item from an array field.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetInt32
methods.description: Adds an integer field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetDouble
methods.description: Adds a double-precision floating point field.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetMessage
methods.description: Adds a nested message as a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string field by name.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBinaryData
methods.description: Retrieves binary data from a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value into a pre-allocated buffer.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an int32_t field by name.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double field by name.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a nested message field.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToString
methods.description: Serializes the message into a string representation.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetSendTopic
methods.description: Gets the topic associated with the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetSendTopic
methods.description: Sets the topic for the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetBool
methods.description: Adds a boolean field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean field.

methods.name: rtMessage_Retain
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and destroys the message if count reaches zero.
